description_en: Queries the information about a monitoring view
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-performance-view-attribute --db-cluster-id amv-bp11q28kvl6880000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --view-name Custom-All_metrics-2_columns-Linked --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribePerformanceViewAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Lakehouse Edition cluster.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/612397.html operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Lakehouse Edition clusters within a region
parameters.help_zh:
<props="china">企业版、基础版或湖仓版集群ID。</props>
<props="intl">湖仓版集群ID。</props>

调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/612397.html接口可以查看集群的集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html接口查看支持的地域和可用区信息，包括地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en:
The details about the access denial.

This parameter is returned only if Resource Access Management (RAM) permission verification failed
AccessDeniedDetail.description_zh: 访问被拒绝详细信息；只有Ram校验失败才会返回此字段

CreateFromViewType.description_zh:
原始图表来源的类型，取值：

Basic：基础视图
Advanced：高级视图

DBClusterId.description_en:
The cluster ID.

You can call the [DescribeDBClusters]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html） operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters within a region, including cluster IDs

FillOriginViewKeys.description_en:
Specifies whether to populate the names of the metrics in the original monitoring view when you view the monitoring view. Valid values:

true
false
FillOriginViewKeys.description_zh:
查看监控视图时，是否填充原始监控视图完成的Key。取值：

true
false

ViewDetail.description_en: The information about the monitoring view

WorkLoad
ResourceGroup

false
